page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Optimized3.Flex.18-144 is an x86_64 virtual machine instance powered by an Intel Xeon 6354 processor operating at a base frequency of 3.0 GHz. The instance is configured with 18 physical cores and 36 dedicated vCPUs with hyperthreading enabled at two threads per core. Memory allocation totals 144.0 GB of RAM, establishing a balanced 1:4 ratio of 4.0 GB of memory per vCPU.

The instance does not include integrated graphics processing units (0 GPUs) and does not come provisioned with local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external network block volumes for persistent data and operating system installations. Network connectivity includes one complimentary public IPv4 address alongside dedicated compute resource allocation that eliminates noisy-neighbor CPU contention.

With its 3.0 GHz clock speed and balanced memory allocation, the VM.Optimized3.Flex.18-144 delivers consistent CPU execution across multithreaded workloads. The architecture fits enterprise web services, application middle-tiers, distributed microservices, CI/CD build environments, and containerized backends requiring dedicated processor capacity without requiring local scratch disks.

Its dedicated compute topology prevents virtualization contention, making it suitable for multi-threaded enterprise services, middle-tier application platforms, integration pipelines, and compute workloads requiring sustained clock performance.
